description: This pie chart illustrates the win rate percentages for three large language models: GPT-4o, Mistral, and LLaMA. The chart contains three slices, each representing one of the models. GPT-4o is represented by a large, maroon slice and is labeled as 98.4%. Mistral is shown as a smaller, reddish-brown slice labeled 1.2%. LLaMA is represented by a very small, gray slice labeled 3.2%. Percentage labels are displayed directly alongside each slice with connecting lines. The chart does not include a separate legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest, moving clockwise.
